citations.claim: cart exceeds track at first violating step
cart already near end and moving outward before violation
steady drift outward earlier with pole still upright

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.00537 to 0.0 only; drift disappears and no violation in 374 steps

explanation: Controller balances pole (theta ~ -0.08 at violation) but with seeded sensor noise the state estimate / feedback slowly drives cart negative; velocity grows increasingly negative (-0.19 at step 100, -0.39 at 200, -0.80 at 300, -1.37 at 374) causing unbounded drift off track. Zeroing noise removes failure, implicating noise-biased feedback / lack of cart centering.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart sits at the far left edge of the track with the pole still upright and balanced. Across steps 371 to 374 it drifts further left while the pole stays vertical, exiting the allowed track region.
